author: Clint Mckeith
text: Nothing wrong if you apply a new sensor while the second one runs out, You can start the new one and hour or 2 before the one expires if that helps, we used to wait for it to run out before applying a new one and sometimes it mean that the warm up period can end at 9:30pm if we didn't change it at 8:30, we just went ahead and applied a new one at 6:30 and it was active at 7:30pm, we did what worked for us.Hope this helps.
